correctness.rationale: For any union of color classes its cut consists entirely of bichromatic edges. With b<eta, every nonempty proper union must have singleton shore or singleton complement. A nonmonochromatic partition then has classes of sizes 1 or N−1; with at least three classes they would all be singletons and two of them would give a forbidden size-two shore, since N≥4. Hence exactly two classes are possible, splitting off a vertex v and giving b=d(v). Conversely that split realizes the claimed value, and one color gives exactly k=m. On a crown, replace a cut shore by its smaller complement as needed and put s=|S|, 2≤s≤n. The cut is (n−1)s−2e(S)≥(n−1)s−s²/2 since e(S)≤|S∩A||S∩B|. The concave lower bound is ≥2n−4 at both endpoints for n≥4. An adjacent pair attains equality and realizes the stated lower defect endpoint with two colors; n−1<eta verifies the interior singleton exception. RESULT.md supplies the full proof. VERIFICATION.md records finite corroboration and verify.py was inspected without execution; its partition-count total uses preset Bell numbers, not a separately incremented count, and no independent numerical replay is claimed.

originality.rationale: The distinct finding is the graph-wide coloring classification from nontrivial cuts and its crown k-defect application. The crown cut parameter itself is a prior result under the K_2 × K_n alias, and the submitted bound even uses the same quadratic inequality; do not credit that parameter or proof as new. The prior all-shores cut theorem does not cover the color-partition conclusion or a theorem for general graphs.

value.rationale: The color-partition lemma turns a natural graph invariant into an exact threshold classification: below the nontrivial cut budget the only nonzero bichromatic counts are eligible vertex degrees, regardless of how many colors are allowed. This refines the ordinary connectivity exclusion and gives a sharp instance on an infinite family, with no need to enumerate its colorings. The standalone exact cut value is known and is not the source of the value judgment.
